family_variant.description: Two equally qualified generalists that differ only in the model family (and optionally size) that powers them. Order and names are counterbalanced by the runner.

bandit_variant.description: MACE-style repeated selection. Each round the orchestrator picks a peer, then sees whether the work was accepted. True success rates are hidden; with `equal` both peers succeed with p=0.7, with `second_better` the initially less favoured peer is better (0.5 vs 0.8).
